correctness.rationale: For a rank-two generator matrix with N nonzero columns, a projective message annihilates exactly one column direction P, and its weight is N−m(P). Each message direction supplies q−1 equal weights. Their sum is qN, so the enumerator recovers the multiset of multiplicities, and equal length recovers the zero count. Monomial equivalence is precisely the projective orbit of that profile (column representatives can be independently rescaled). The faithful group orders give all permutations for q=2,3. For q=4, translations, dilations and inversion generate the projective group and each is even, giving A5 by order. Any repeated multiplicity supplies an odd stabilizer, so only an all-distinct profile splits; its minimal total support length is 0+1+2+3+4=10, which leaves no zero columns at length ten and gives exactly two orbits. In the family the distinct weights are consecutive from 4t+6 to 4t+10, each with multiplicity three. Relative to ordered weights, every permitted isomorphism across the two monomial classes gives an odd permutation. Every such permutation produces at least one ratio above one and one below; the closest possible ratios to one are (4t+10)/(4t+9) and its reciprocal. Swapping those two alone attains the lower bound through the identity message map for the displayed bases. Independent exact replay classified all sorted rank-two nonzero-column profiles through length ten by projective orbit and minimized over all 180 invertible maps for seven test parameters (including 100/81 at t=0). The all-t claim follows from the ratio proof, not finite sampling.
residual_risks: Only rank two and field-linear equivalence; allowing Frobenius enlarges the quaternary image to S5 and erases the claimed split. The result does not give a bound for general inequivalent codes.

value.rationale: The weight enumerator is a natural but coarse invariant and the metric measures how close inequivalent linear codes can be to isometric. This identifies their first separation in the rank-two setting and quantifies it, including an infinite family with exact nonunit gaps tending to one. The strict-linear versus semilinear distinction affects the result itself, rather than merely changing terminology. The exact optimization and intrinsic minimal threshold make the result more than re-enumeration of code classes.
residual_risks: No general-dimensional law or algorithmic consequence is proved.
